title: fix(server): reject non-loopback Host on write APIs (DNS-rebind guard)
why:
The /api/preferences + /api/translation-requests POST endpoints now
require a 127.0.0.1/localhost Host header, blocking a remote page from
rebinding a hostname to loopback and writing .lore/.state. Writes were
already confined to .state, but this closes the request-forgery vector.
